data.name: Main_NewEditor
data.comment: Sidebar button that opens an empty image editor window.

data.name: Main_ScreenCapture
data.comment: Sidebar button that starts a new region capture.

data.name: Main_Tagline
data.comment: Subtitle under the CLOWD wordmark in the main window. "Clowd" itself is a brand name and is never translated.

data.name: Nav_About
data.comment: Navigation item: version, license and credits.

data.name: Nav_RecentSessions
data.comment: Navigation item: list of recent captures, recordings and uploads. Keep short — the sidebar is narrow.

data.name: Nav_SettingsCapture
data.comment: Navigation item: settings for the screen-capture overlay.

data.name: Nav_SettingsEditor
data.comment: Navigation item: settings for the image editor.

data.name: Nav_SettingsGeneral
data.comment: Navigation item: general application settings.

data.name: Nav_SettingsHotkeys
data.comment: Navigation item: global keyboard shortcuts.

data.name: Nav_SettingsRecording
data.comment: Navigation item: settings for screen (video) recording.

data.name: Nav_SettingsUploads
data.comment: Navigation item: upload destinations and credentials.

data.name: Tray_CaptureScreen
data.comment: Tray menu item: start a screen capture.

data.name: Tray_ColorPicker
data.comment: Tray menu item: opens the screen color picker.

data.name: Tray_Exit
data.comment: Tray menu item: quits Clowd.

data.name: Tray_ImageEditor
data.comment: Tray menu item: opens an empty image editor window.

data.name: Tray_RecentsAndUploads
data.comment: Tray menu item: opens the Recent page.

data.name: Tray_Settings
data.comment: Tray menu item: opens the settings window on the General page.

data.name: Tray_StartStopRecording
data.comment: Tray menu item: one item toggles video recording on and off.

data.name: Tray_UploadClipboard
data.comment: Tray menu item: uploads the current clipboard contents.

data.name: Tray_UploadFile
data.comment: Tray menu item: opens a file picker, then uploads the chosen files. Keep the trailing ellipsis (…), it means "this opens a dialog".
